# Jay Saadana

> Official portfolio of Jay Saadana, a Developer Relations professional and Head of Developer Growth at Agentr, working on Webcmd and developer ecosystems for web-enabled AI agents.

Jay's work covers developer community growth, open source, technical education, partnerships, developer experience, and AI agents. This site contains his professional experience, selected projects, writing, and collaborator testimonials.
